subject_uz: Qarshi shahri "Shayx-Ali" MFY hududiga boradigan 219-159 mm yer osti gaz quvurini "shablayn" usulida mukammal ta'mirlash

requirements.summary_uz: Qarshi shahridagi 219-159 mm yer osti gaz quvuri "shablayn" usulida mukammal ta'mirlanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Major repair of the 219-159 mm underground gas pipeline in Karshi by the sliplining method.
requirements.quote: yer osti kesimi 219-159 mm bo’lgan gaz quvurini “shablayn” usulida mukammal ta’mirlash xizmatini

requirements.summary_uz: Gaz xo'jaligida po'lat va polietilen gaz tarmoqlarini qurish, ta'mirlash va foydalanishga topshirish bo'yicha litsenziya talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: A licence for building, repairing and commissioning steel and polyethylene gas networks is required.
requirements.quote: Gaz xoʻjaligida past, oʻrta va yuqori, yer osti va yer usti po’lat va polietilen gaz tarmoqlarini qurish, taʼmirlash, rejim-sozlash va foydalanishga topshirish boʻyicha litsenziyaga ega boʻlishi lozim

requirements.summary_uz: Loyihani bajarish uchun zarur mashina, mexanizmlar va kichik mexanizatsiya vositalari ro'yxati yoki shartnoma nusxasi biriktiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: A list of machines, mechanisms and small mechanisation tools (or a lease contract copy) must be attached.
requirements.quote: Loyihani amalga oshirish uchun zarur bo'lgan mashina va mexanizmlarning hamda kichik hajmdagi mexanizatsiyalash vositalarining mavjudligi.

requirements.summary_uz: Doimiy xodimlar soni my.gov.uz ma'lumotnomasi bilan baholanadi: 25 va undan ko'p 10 ball, 15 dan kam bo'lsa 0 ball va diskvalifikatsiya.
requirements.summary_en: Permanent staff is scored via a my.gov.uz certificate: 25 or more gets 10 points, fewer than 15 gets 0 and disqualification.
requirements.quote: Doimiy ishlaydigan ish stajiga ega bo'lgan rahbar xodirnlarning va

requirements.summary_uz: Kompaniya tashkil etilgan vaqti uchun ball: 10 yil va undan ko'p 10 ball, 5-10 yil 5 ball, 1-5 yil 2 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Company age is scored: 10+ years 10 points, 5-10 years 5, 1-5 years 2.
requirements.quote: 10 yil va undan yuqori - 10 ball 5 yildan 10 yilgacha - 5 ball

requirements.summary_uz: O'xshash ishlar bo'yicha shartnomalar, dalolatnomalar va fotosuratlar ro'yxati baholanadi; 6 va undan ko'p shartnoma 10 ball.
requirements.summary_en: A list of similar works with contracts, acceptance acts and photos is scored; 6 or more contracts gets 10 points.
requirements.quote: Ushbu loyihaga o‘xshash ishlarni (xizmatlarni) bajarganlik ro‘yxati.

requirements.summary_uz: Qurilish vazirligi reyting.mc.uz saytidagi reyting: DDD va yuqori 10 ball, DD 5 ball, D yoki reyting yo'q bo'lsa 0 ball va diskvalifikatsiya.
requirements.summary_en: Construction ministry rating on reyting.mc.uz: DDD or higher 10 points, DD 5, D or no rating 0 and disqualification.
requirements.quote: Reyting DDD va undan yuqori - 10 ball. Reyting DD – 5 ball. D yoki reyting bo'lmasa - 0 ball diskvalifikatsiya

requirements.summary_uz: 2025 yil bank aylanmasi baholanadi: 5 mlrd so'm va undan ko'p 10 ball, 1-5 mlrd 5 ball, 1 mlrd gacha 2 ball.
requirements.summary_en: 2025 bank turnover is scored: 5 billion UZS or more 10 points, 1-5 billion 5, under 1 billion 2.
requirements.quote: 5 mlrd so'm va undan yuqori -10 ball 1 milliarddan 5 milliard so‘mgacha-5 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Buyurtmachi belgilagan ob'ekt marjinal qiymatining 20 foizi miqdorida aylanma mablag'lar bo'lishi kerak (bank kafolat xati).
requirements.summary_en: Working capital equal to 20 percent of the object's marginal value must be shown (bank letter).
requirements.quote: Buyurtmachi tomonidan belgilangan ob'ektning marjinal qiymatining 20% miqdorida aylanma mablag'larning mavjudligi

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi taklifi 30 kalendar kundan kam bo'lmagan muddat amal qilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bid must remain valid for at least 30 calendar days.
requirements.quote: Taklifning amal qilish muddati 30 kalendar kunidan kam boʻlmasligi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy va kadrlar resurslari mavjud bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have the technical, financial, material and staff resources needed for the contract.
requirements.quote: shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy, kadrlar resurslarining hamda boshqa resurslarning mavjudligi;

flags.explanation_uz: Aylanma bo'yicha to'liq 10 ball uchun 5 mlrd so'm talab qilinadi, bu lotning boshlang'ich narxi (894 054 300 so'm) dan taxminan 5,6 baravar ko'p. Platforma shaklida o'tish bali 75 deb ko'rsatilgan, mezonlar yig'indisi esa 85 ball: ya'ni jami 10 ball yo'qotish mumkin. Aylanmasi 1-5 mlrd so'm bo'lgan korxona bu mezonda kamida 5 ball yo'qotadi va o'tish bali xavf ostida qoladi. Shuncha aylanma zarurligini tekshirib ko'rish kerak.
flags.explanation_en: Full 10 points need a 2025 turnover of 5 billion UZS, about 5.6 times the lot's start price of 894,054,300 UZS. The platform form shows a pass mark of 75 while the listed criteria add up to 85 points, so only 10 points can be lost in total. A firm with 1-5 billion turnover loses at least 5 points here, which puts the pass mark at risk. A person should check whether this scale of turnover is needed.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib moliyaviy talab (6-bet): Aylanma bo'yicha to'liq 10 ball uchun 5 mlrd so'm talab qilinadi, bu lotning boshlang'ich narxi (894 054 300 so'm) dan taxminan 5,6 baravar ko'p. Platforma shaklida o'tish bali 75 deb ko'rsatilgan, mezonlar yig'indisi esa 85 ball: ya'ni jami 10 ball yo'qotish mumkin. Aylanmasi 1-5 mlrd so'm bo'lgan korxona bu mezonda kamida 5 ball yo'qotadi va o'tish bali xavf ostida qoladi. Shuncha aylanma zarurligini tekshirib ko'rish kerak.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (5-bet): Kompaniyaning yoshi 10 ball beradi: 10 yildan kam faoliyat yuritgan korxona 5 ball, 5 yildan kam bo'lsa 8 ball yo'qotadi. O'tish bali 75 (jami 85 ball) bo'lgani uchun faqat 10 ball yo'qotish mumkin. Yoshi kam, lekin litsenziyasi, texnikasi va tajribasi bor korxona yetarli bilimga ega bo'lsa ham o'ta olmasligi mumkin. Kompaniya yoshi ishning sifatini oldindan ko'rsatmasligi sababli bu mezonning zarurligini aniqlashtirish kerak.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (5-bet): Qurilish vazirligining reytingi bo'lmagan yoki D bo'lgan ishtirokchi 0 ball oladi va diskvalifikatsiya qilinadi; DD reytingi 5 ball yo'qotishga olib keladi. Gaz quvurini ta'mirlash uchun gaz xo'jaligi litsenziyasi allaqachon alohida talab qilinadi, shuning uchun qurilish reytingi qo'shimcha to'siq bo'lishi mumkin. Reytingi yo'q, lekin litsenziyaga ega korxona o'tish balidan (75) o'ta olmaydi. Reyting zarurligini tekshirib ko'rish kerak.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 22 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 64% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 14%.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Financial demand out of proportion to the lot (page 6): Full 10 points need a 2025 turnover of 5 billion UZS, about 5.6 times the lot's start price of 894,054,300 UZS. The platform form shows a pass mark of 75 while the listed criteria add up to 85 points, so only 10 points can be lost in total. A firm with 1-5 billion turnover loses at least 5 points here, which puts the pass mark at risk. A person should check whether this scale of turnover is needed.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 5): Company age is worth 10 points: a firm active for under 10 years loses 5 points, under 5 years loses 8 points. With a pass mark of 75 out of 85 listed points, only 10 points can be lost in total. A younger firm with the licence, equipment and experience may still fail to pass. Since age does not by itself predict quality of the work, a person should check whether this criterion is needed.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 5): A bidder with no construction-ministry rating, or rated D, scores 0 and is disqualified; a DD rating loses 5 points. The gas-network licence is already required separately, so the construction rating may be an extra gate. A licensed firm without the rating cannot reach the pass mark of 75. A person should check whether the rating is needed for this work.
In the customer's last 22 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 64% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 14%.
